title: Hello
description: First frame from the daemon after connecting.

protocols.description: Supported protocol versions, highest priority first.

epoch.description: Outbox epoch; changes only when the state directory is wiped.

last_seq.description: Highest seq sent in this epoch.

acked_cmd_seq.description: Highest console command seq executed and persisted.

features.description: Feature names, e.g. sessions, codex_app_server, git_worktree, git_sync, cred_helper, upgrade, file_download (read_deliverable file.download), shared_files (write_shared_file upload and read_shared_file shared_download into .shared/), context_usage (turn_ended carries context), session_compact (session.compact), usage (node.usage), runtime_status (node.runtimes, node.runtimes_refresh), ssh_gateway (session.open ssh_servers, ssh.cert_request, ssh.servers_update, /nodes/ssh), session_move (session.export, session.open.import, /nodes/moves), self_update (runs under the update launcher: node.upgrade with mode, drain, rollback).

ssh_client.description: OpenSSH client on the node (ssh -V), when found.

build.description: First 8 hex of sha256(node.mjs); the release id is <version>+<build>.

AntigravityRuntime.title: AntigravityRuntime
AntigravityRuntime.description: Google Antigravity CLI (agy, driven over ACP). Reported even when agy is not installed (installed false, auth none) so the node page can say so; the console schedules antigravity sessions only on nodes that report it installed and logged in.

cli.description: agy --version, e.g. 1.5.14; empty when not installed.

auth.description: oauth: a Google account login (agy acp --login); api_key: GEMINI_API_KEY with modelProvider gemini; adc: AGY_ADC_AUTH application default credentials; none: not logged in.

installed.description: false when the agy binary was not found; absent means installed.
